regimeSub: Bond rout extends as 10Y hits 5.18% with Brent cooling to $98 but core PCE stuck at 3.3%.
themes: Warsh's Sept 16 hike to 4.0% continues reverberating → 10Y blows through 5.18% (+7bps WoW) as 30Y yield hits 2004 highs per Reuters Sept 25, 2Y at 4.87% prices another 25bp by Dec while GDP limps at 1.5%

Brent eases to $98.39 from $105+ highs as Saudi output disruptions normalize post-Iran interim deal → oil still elevated vs $93 WTI but stagflation pass-through locked in with Aug CPI at 3.7% and core PCE 3.3%

BOK under pressure from 1%pt Fed rate gap per Korea JoongAng Sept 17 → USDKRW holds 1357 as SK chip boom (SK Hynix overtakes Samsung in mkt cap) supports KRW, but BOK hawk Rhee flags inflation risks from HBM surge

Consumer resilience persists with retail sales +1.2% MoM per Census Sept 16 → SPX grinds to 7743 (+0.5% DoD) but VIX at 14.87 flags complacency as real rates crush duration and gold at $4229 signals stagflation hedging

headline: Bond rout extends with 10Y at 5.18% and 30Y at 2004 highs as Warsh's Sept hike reverberates, but equities grind higher on resilient consumer and AI capex while Brent eases to $98 post-Iran deal.
